owner: main session (PM); sources attested by the human product owner
governing_text: risk/1.9 Rulings 5.1-5.8 (BenchmarkSeries contract, total return, ETF proxies, selection, two sources, Current mode); PD-0039 D1/D5
rules: An entry is selectable by a user (migration 0015) only if it is listed under 'entries'. 'candidates' are never selectable and never read by the engine.

Every entry's source_id must be a source in SOURCES.json whose terms_check passes (market-data Ruling 4.7); synthetic fixture series are never catalogued here (market-data Ruling 4.8: synthetic data stays in fixtures and tests).
return_basis is one of TOTAL_RETURN_NET, TOTAL_RETURN_GROSS, PRICE_RETURN. A PRICE_RETURN entry may be listed for display but is refused for risk metrics (Ruling 5.4).
A change to any field of an entry is a new catalog_id version; manifests cite catalog_id (pinned by benchmark selections as catalog_version).

A benchmark served by more than one admitted source requires a unique positive-integer source_priority on each of those sources in SOURCES.json (1 = primary; risk/1.2 Ruling 5.7). A missing or repeated priority refuses the benchmark (MISSING_BENCHMARK, BENCHMARK_SERIES_UNAVAILABLE).

entry_fields.benchmark_id: stable id, independent of the source
entry_fields.name: index name, or 'proxy: <listing>' (Ruling 5.5)
entry_fields.provider: index provider, or the ETF issuer for a proxy
entry_fields.return_basis: TOTAL_RETURN_NET | TOTAL_RETURN_GROSS | PRICE_RETURN, with the provider's dividend-treatment statement
entry_fields.dividend_treatment: provider's statement (for NET: the withholding basis)
entry_fields.series_form: LEVELS | RETURNS (returns are compounded into levels exactly, Ruling 5.1)
entry_fields.proxy_of: null, or the index an ETF proxy stands for (Ruling 5.5)
entry_fields.proxy_listing_id: UUID of the ETF listing an ETF proxy is built from (Ruling 5.5); null unless proxy_of is set
entry_fields.additional_sources: optional list of {source_id, return_basis, precision_decimals} for further SOURCES.json sources serving this benchmark; each must carry the entry's return_basis and declare precision_decimals (risk/1.6-1.9 Rulings 5.7); a source not listed is never used; a multi-source entry with any precision undeclared is refused (BENCHMARK_SERIES_UNAVAILABLE); absent from digests when empty
entry_fields.official_decimals: integer: the index's official published decimals (risk/1.9 declared precision)
entry_fields.precision_decimals: integer: the primary source's declared published decimals (risk/1.9; market-data Ruling 4.2 per-source bound)

candidates.note: Not admitted. PD-0039 D1: real benchmark data is decided by the owner before HG3. Any real source must provide TOTAL RETURN (risk/1.1 Ruling 5.4). Listed so the decision has a starting point; details are from memory and unverified.
examples: US broad-market total-return index (e.g. S&P 500 TR) or a labelled ETF proxy (e.g. SPY with dividends reinvested)
